newsitem.title: USA: Vons says will study Safeway offer.
newsitem.headline: Vons says will study Safeway offer.

text.p: Vons Cos Inc said on Wednesday it will study the $58.00 share offer made for the grocery store chain earlier today by Safeway Inc.
In a brief statement, Vons said the deal will be reviewed by a committee of Vons' outside directors, and the company will respond "in due course."
Several Safeway managers currently sit on Vons' board.

Safeway, which operates 1,050 grocery stores in the United States and Canada, offered to swap 1.34 of its shares for each Vons share. If consummated, a merger of the two would create the nation's second largest grocery chain with 1,375 stores.
